votes.motion: Commissioner Squire motioned to nominate Andrew Adams as Chair for 2022
Commissioner Tonks motioned to nominate Craig Hawker as Vice Chair for 2022

Commissioner Squire motioned to approve the site plan as requested by Nathan Abbot of the Galloway & Co. representing Boyer, Bangerter and Draper Hotel Partners, property owners, Application SPR-982-2021, based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the staff report, dated December 7, 2021

Commissioner Tonks motioned to approve the plat amendment as requested by Nathan Abbot of the Galloway & Co. representing Boyer, Bangerter and Draper Hotel Partners, property owners, Application SUBD-081-2021, based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the staff report, dated December 7, 2021

Commissioner Tonks motioned to forward a positive recommendation to the city council of the map amendment as requested by Howard Cooke representing Gardner Company for Vista 600 West Master Area Plan Amendment, Application TEXTMAP-0109-2021, based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the staff report, dated December 7, 2021

Commissioner Van Hoff motioned to forward a positive recommendation to the city council of the text amendment as requested by Howard Cooke representing Gardner Company for Vista 600 West Master Area Plan Amendment, Application TEXTMAP-0109-2021, based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the staff report, dated December 7, 2021

Commissioner Squire motioned for adjournment, Chairman Adams asked all those in favor say “Aye”, Commissioners Squire, Hawker, Van Hoff, Tonks and Bingham said “Aye”. The meeting adjourned at 6:58 p.m. 5
